props.termsBody:
Rates are quoted on enquiry and depend on design, quantity and whether the order is wholesale or retail. Wholesale rates apply above the minimum quantity confirmed at the time of order.

Orders are confirmed once size, colour and design are agreed and payment is received. A payment screenshot along with the complete delivery address is required before an order is packed. A tracking ID is shared once the parcel is dispatched.

Colours shown in photographs and on screens are indicative. Slight variation between the photograph and the delivered garment can occur with dyed fabric and is not treated as a defect.

Sizes vary between designs and manufacturers. Please confirm measurements before ordering, particularly for plus sizes.

Damage or a wrong item must be reported with an unedited parcel-opening video within 24 hours of delivery. Claims without it cannot be verified and cannot be accepted.

We are open all days, 12 noon to 10 PM, except Holi.
